test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

AMOUNT : QWYKXJ :: MARKET :: ?
solution:
The table of alphabet place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

AMOUNT : QWYKXJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/202e60bae98fa4ede47bd571d0fe5c3d7f7924eaacfedfa8fe3929fdc555e4b4.png] 

Similarly,

MARKET : '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1ec29a6e6c610faef23593bdee043fbc3e9317b816858cacf2b95c0ed862476.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"EIONXA".**
